item.title: 1.0.1-beta.1
item.description: - Drag the edge of the sidebar, the panel on the right or Focus's drawer to resize it, and the list of repositories when they're in one. They grow as far as the window allows, leaving the middle at least 400 points. Double-click the edge to put it back. Kaern keeps the sizes for next time. - ↑ and ↓ move through the files of a commit or of your changes once you click one, in the panel and in Focus's drawer. Held down, they keep going, in the history too, and back from Review the history takes them without a click. - The branch you're on stays in its place in the sidebar, inside its folder, instead of moving to the top. A folded folder that holds it shows a check. - When several branches or tags point at one commit, the history shows one label and "+2". Rest the pointer on it and every label unfolds in a list, with its whole name and its right-click menu. - Double-click a branch's label in the history, or in its "+2" list, to switch to it, as in the sidebar. A remote branch's label checks out a local branch that tracks it. - Double-click a worktree in the sidebar, or a branch checked out in one, to open that worktree in a tab of its own. Right-click a worktree to open it, show or copy its folder, lock it, or remove it with or without its branch. A branch checked out in another worktree offers Open Worktree instead of Checkout, and no Delete while that worktree is there. - In a narrow panel, a file whose folder doesn't fit shows just its name, without a sliver of the folder.

The first release of Kaern, a native Git client for macOS. Free and open source.
- **Every repository in reach.** Repositories open in tabs, in a list beside the history, or behind one toolbar button, and related ones can share a group. The windows and tabs you had open come back the next time. - **A history you can read.** Branches keep their colors, runs of bot updates fold into one row, signed commits show who signed them, and search and Quick Open find any commit, branch or file. - **See exactly what changed.** Split or unified diffs down to the word, images compared side by side, with a swipe or as an onion skin, and the history and blame of every line. - **Commit exactly what you mean.** Stage single lines, and take back almost anything with ⌘Z: discarded changes are kept in Stashes. - **Branch, merge and rewrite with confidence.** Compare branches, rebase interactively, resolve merge conflicts side by side, and work in several worktrees. - **Nothing hidden.** Kaern runs the git you already have, with your config, your hooks and your SSH keys, and its Command Log shows every command it ran. It needs no account.
Kaern needs macOS 26 or later on a Mac with Apple silicon, and keeps itself up to date.
